criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1, 9 and 5 are strong, though 5's columns cover maybe 15 percent of the frame and its turbine hub sits below the column top. Slide 2 is a mottled beige card in the mid tones with shadow streak acne. Slide 6 has a lavender mid-tone ground, ghosted turbines, card flagging and a hairline wood line. Slide 3's bays are flat orange slabs not registered to the louvres over a black void. Slide 4's bushings hover over a primitive box. Slide 8's chain floats unattached. Slide 7 reads as a striped rug. The type sits on true dark everywhere with no plates.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One road world at last light, one type system, the accent doing real work as planned. The fence motif doesn't work. Slides 2 and 6 sit outside the value register. Four low-eye shots and the headline on top on all nine.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the data-driven art checks out to measurement. Held under 10 for slide 5's hook dropping up to and every figure being the company's own.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, the condition and the timing land. The deciding body and date are not established.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and the turn on 5 lands. Slide 7 revisits slide 2 and slides 4 and 6 both stand on the substation.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Regional and specific with headlines that have spine, house clean, flattening into attribution chains in places.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and cover move, with lastLight, the transformer bay, survey stakes, the shut gate and the squares caveat familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Re-stage frames 2 and 6 the way 1, 5 and 9 are staged, one lit pool on near-black ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mottled beige card in the mid tones, a tray, streak acne in the lower neighbour.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken the plateau and light it only with a pool on Silverton, the neighbours to near black, a taller cliff, crop in so Briscoe fills about 70 percent of the width.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lavender mid-tone ground, ghosted turbines, card flagging, a hairline wood line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark red earth outside one pool on the substation and stakes, cut the haze on the turbines, draped flagging, two or three H-frames forward.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat orange slabs not registered to the louvres, a black void below.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Emissive behind the louvre blades with warm spill, camera lower and in so the lit pad fills the lower third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The chain floats unattached and the seam post renders as two fused cylinders.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One continuous chain wrapped twice round the latch stiles, the padlock hung by its shackle.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bushings hover over a primitive box, the chain link only in a corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat the bushings on flanged turrets with contact, add a conservator, bring the mesh across the near foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Thin columns, lime ticks, the turbine hub below the column top.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera in and lower so the columns span a third of the width, hub level with the 30th flange, rims held to the accent hex.
